Container.Name: binhex-official-filebrowser-quantum
Container.Overview: FileBrowser Quantum is an actively maintained fork of the original filebrowser with full-text search, previews and thumbnails, sharing links, multi-source support and optional OIDC, LDAP and proxy authentication. Its primary configuration is config.yaml inside the data volume, so most settings are edited there rather than exposed here; the environment variables below cover secrets and overrides.
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider buying me a beer :D

Config.Name: Port: Web Interface
Config.Description: This is the TCP port for the FileBrowser Quantum WebUI. The container listens on port 80 because the image healthcheck and the shipped config require it, so change the host port here rather than http.port in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Path: /home/filebrowser/data
Config.Description: This is the container path to your configuration file, database and cache, so it must persist. The image runs as UID:GID 1000:1000; to run it as a different user set --user in extra parameters and give this host directory matching ownership.

Config.Name: Path: /srv
Config.Description: This is the path FileBrowser indexes as its default source. Narrow this to a specific share rather than all of /mnt/user, and add further sources in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password. Leave blank to keep the upstream behaviour: a random admin password is generated, written to the container log once, and a reset is forced at first login.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_JWT_TOKEN_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens. Changing it after first start invalidates all existing sessions.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_TOTP_SECRET
Config.Description: Encryption secret for stored TOTP two-factor secrets. Set it before enrolling users in TOTP.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_RECAPTCHA_SECRET
Config.Description: reCAPTCHA secret key used by password authentication when reCAPTCHA is enabled in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_LDAP_USER_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password of the LDAP bind account used to look up users.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: OIDC client id for single sign-on, for example from Authentik, Keycloak or Pocket ID.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: OIDC client secret for single sign-on.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ONLYOFFICE_SECRET
Config.Description: JWT secret shared with your OnlyOffice document server.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_CONFIG
Config.Description: Path to the configuration file. Leave blank to use the image default of /home/filebrowser/data/config.yaml inside the data volume.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database. Leave blank to use the image default of /home/filebrowser/data/database.sqlite. A path set in config.yaml takes precedence over this variable.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_FFMPEG_PATH
Config.Description: Directory holding the ffmpeg and ffprobe binaries. Leave blank to use the image default of /usr/local/bin. Only the full image bundles ffmpeg, not the slim variant.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_BACKUP
Config.Description: Automatic backups are on by default. Set this to true to disable the backup taken automatically before an upgrade.
